label.es: Supervisora de recepción de hotel → mejor carrera

text: Daniela Pérez (fictional demo profile). Lives in Hialeah, Miami-Dade, for 15 years. Front Desk Supervisor at a 300-room hotel in Miami Beach for 8 years (before that 2 years as front desk agent). Supervises a team of 9 agents, builds weekly schedules, handles guest complaints and escalations, trains new hires, uses the hotel's property management system (Opera) and Excel for shift reports, handles cash drawer reconciliation. Bilingual English/Spanish. High school diploma, no college degree. Current pay about $42,000 a year. Wants a better-paid, more stable job with regular hours (tired of nights and weekends), open to tech or healthcare but doesn't know which role fits. Can study evenings, about 8 hours per week. Low budget — prefers free or low-cost options. Has a car.
